jooking: Standing, "jooking" a foreign stalk in--tamarind, star apple, almond--and strapping it into the gummy gash dug into the tree's side.
jook: "He say yo' had no business to jook yo' mout' in de ruction yestiddy.
'Yo' brute,' he say, 'yo' whelp, yo' wan' to jook out my eye, no!
jookin: "Always jookin' yo' han' in yo' matty saucepan," cried April.
